decision: held: source inaccessible. 30385422 (J Ethnopharmacol 2019) has no open-access full text (no PMC copy), so the ten trials' preparations, doses, forms and populations cannot be verified as Dr. Pham requested.
summary: The abstract reports 10 T2DM trials (n=1045, 4-16 weeks, moderate-high risk of bias): monoherbal M. charantia vs placebo lowered FPG (-0.72 mmol/L), PPG (-1.43 mmol/L) and HbA1c (-0.26%), with low to very low quality evidence for the primary outcomes. Without the methods and trial table no context can be completed; the record stays held.

source_receipts.title_fetched: Momordica charantia L. lowers elevated glycaemia in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
